question: Which academic institution in India has installed the most powerful supercomputer in the country named as Param Pravega, the supercomputer is also the largest in an Indian academic institution as on February 2022?

options.text: Inter-University Centre for Astronomy and Astrophysics(IUCAA) - Pune
Indian Institutes of Science Education and Research(IISER) -Tirupati

solution:
The correct answer is the **Indian Institute of Science (IISc) - Bengaluru**.
